# Sendagaya Shino / 千駄ヶ谷篠

Original character: pixiv Inc., VRoid Project (VRoid Studio beta sample).
License: **CC0 1.0**, as stated by the original publisher and embedded in this VRM.

- Official model and terms: https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/articles/360013482714-Sendagaya-Shino
- CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Download mirror: https://github.com/madjin/vrm-samples/blob/master/vroid/beta/Sendagaya_Shino.vrm
- Retrieved: 2026-09-10. Original download and SHA-256 evidence are retained in `reports/phase8/map4-anime-third-person-20260910/` at the workspace root.

Converted with installed Blender 5.2.0 LTS: glTF import, FBX skeleton/mesh export, texture extraction. No VRM Unity package is required. Mesh design and textures are retained; Unity adds a staff and uses the standard URP Unlit shader to preserve the painted anime colors. The FBX and PNG derivatives retain CC0. The controller, relaxed idle and short staff hold/cast clips are project integration assets.

Since 2026-09-11, locomotion retargets Unity Technologies' female walk/run/sprint clips; their separate source and Unity Companion License are in `Assets/ThirdParty/UnityFemaleMotion/`. The original guard animation assets are unchanged.

This model is the beta Sendagaya Shino character. It is not one of the current VRoidPreset A–Z models with different terms.
